decision: accept exact conditional local comparison and local-factor proof
author: /root/v14_sign_conductor
independent_reading: Direct visual reading of Silverman printed45,186,196,201,449; revised full proof and current13668–13676. The source criteria have no residue-characteristic exclusion at q=3.
findings: Fixed local minimal invariant differential normalization is essential; arbitrary nonunit rescaling is excluded.
Four odd dyadic unit classes and unit-square isomorphism preserve comparison valuations.
Fixed bad-prime local classes give finitely many nonzero Euler factors.
At active good odd q, ramified quadratic twist is bad by NOS, unchanged integral j excludes multiplicative reduction; additive factor is one, including q=3.
At unused good odd q, unramified twist remains good and its point count supplies the norm polynomial value.
Global period and Kato norm inputs remain separate.
details: The lift increment 2^(n-1) adjusts an odd square modulo2^(n+1) and converges. The displayed twist isomorphism pulls back the differential by u^(-1); minimal differentials differ by units. Ramified inertia acts by -1 on V2 at odd q, excluding good reduction; minimal-model c4/Delta criterion and unchanged integral j exclude multiplicative reduction. C.16 then gives factor1. Good Euler factors are nonzero by the identity point, and multiplicative factors 1±1/p are nonzero. Unused-prime character point counting gives the stated polynomial.
limits: Accepts only the stated fixed minimal local-generator convention and given good/active/unused prime hypotheses. Does not establish global reciprocity, original rational period comparison, Kato norm relation, detailed source-use mappings or final source adoption. Prior root suggestion disclosed; independently checked here.
